response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and notable geospatial contributions via GISCollective, but lacks direct C++/Rust experience in routing, navigation, or distributed data pipelines — key requirements for the role. His DLang and Node.js work shows systems-level aptitude, but the absence of proven expertise in routing tile generation, real-time traffic integration, or low-latency geospatial processing raises significant gaps.
strengths: Proven geospatial project experience with GISCollective and Open Green Map
Strong systems-level coding background in DLang, Linux, and high-performance I/O
Demonstrated ability to learn and contribute across diverse technical stacks
concerns: No demonstrated commercial experience with C++ or Rust in routing or navigation systems
Lack of evidence in distributed systems, fault tolerance, or routing tile optimization
Minimal mention of real-time data integration, data consistency, or navigation QA practices
